acf.s101_p: Cyprus real estate can be more than an income-producing asset held in euros. Owning at Elysia Blu also opens a route to permanent residence in Cyprus for your whole family.
acf.s102_h2:
Your route to
permanent residence in Cyprus
acf.s104_p: A qualifying property starts at €300,000 plus VAT and must be bought new from the developer.
acf.s106_p: The application can include you, your spouse, and your dependent children. Besides owning the property, you need to show a secured annual income.
acf.s108_p: You need to visit Cyprus once every 2 years to keep the status.
acf.s109_p: Cyprus permanent residence is the right to live in Cyprus; it is not Cypriot citizenship, and it does not give the right to live or work across the whole EU.
acf.s111_p: What Cyprus permanent residence gives you
acf.s115_li: You and your family can live, study, and do business in Cyprus with the rights of a permanent resident.
acf.s116_li: Access to a European standard of living, a Mediterranean climate, and an international community.
acf.s117_li: Visa applications to other European countries can be more straightforward, depending on each country's rules.
acf.s121_li: A healthcare system to European standards, subject to the conditions of the General Healthcare System (GESY).
acf.s122_li: Education on the British model, which suits a long-term education plan for your children.
acf.s123_li: Corporate tax of 15% from 2026, among the more competitive rates in Europe.
acf.s124_li: Personal tax depends on your tax residence status, your sources of income, and the rules in force.
acf.s127_h3: Points to note about permanent residence
acf.s128_li: Cyprus permanent residence is not Cypriot citizenship.
acf.s129_li: The right to live and work in other EU countries arises only if you hold EU citizenship or a valid residence or work permit in that country.
acf.s130_li: Your right to work and do business, and the tax treatment that applies, must be assessed against the program conditions and each investor's own file.
acf.s133_p: The physical permanent residence card is renewed every 5 years, provided you still own the property.
acf.s134_h4: Meet the residence and language conditions
acf.s135_p: At least 8 years of physical residence within an 11-year period, Greek language at CEFR level B1, and a pass in the cultural integration test.
acf.s137_p: Dual citizenship is allowed. A Cypriot passport gives visa-free travel to more than 170 destinations.
